title: Gentle Foot Compression
summary: The hands gently enclose the foot and apply brief even compression.
goal: Provide calm, even pressure to the foot.
startingPosition: The foot is fully supported between the hands.
instructions: Place the hands on both sides of the foot.
warning: Do not massage with recent injury, marked swelling, ulcers, infection, severe pain, or impaired sensation unless medically advised.
imageAlt: Educational diagram: gentle foot compression, without text labels.
